description: Source code for the rx::ShaderD3D class implementing shader compilation and management for Direct3D in the ANGLE project.

classes.name: TranslateTaskD3D
classes.description: Encapsulates a task to compile shader source code into HLSL using a handle and options.

classes.name: WaitableCompileEventD3D
classes.description: A waitable event for shader compilation that supports post-translation processing.

methods.name: ShaderD3D
methods.description: Constructor that initializes shader options based on features and extensions.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::getDebugInfo
methods.description: Returns debug information string for the shader.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::uncompile
methods.description: Resets internal shader state and debug info.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::generateWorkarounds
methods.description: Generates workarounds for known D3D compiler issues based on shader usage.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::getUniformRegister
methods.description: Retrieves the register index for a given uniform name.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::useImage2DFunction
methods.description: Checks if a specific image2D function is used in the shader.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::compile
methods.description: Compiles the shader source into HLSL asynchronously, returning a waitable event.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::hasUniform
methods.description: Checks if a uniform with the given name exists in the shader.
